takes.p: From tonight the Night Wire assembles itself at midnight Central: headlines from the presses, labels, shops and magazines that cover this beat, each linked back to whoever reported it. If something belongs here and keeps missing the cut, write in. The filters are a set of opinions, and opinions can be argued with.

Every October the rest of the culture rents our shelf for a month and gives it back with the corners bent. Enjoy the attention. Buy the reissue you have been circling. Then remember that the people who kept this material alive did it in March, in a back room, for nobody.

Buy two. It sounds like an indulgence until you have watched a beloved paperback die of being loved. One copy goes on the shelf and stays square. The other goes in the coat pocket, the bath and the waiting room, which is where books like these were always meant to be read.
